title: 感覚機能論
subtitle: Sensory Information
keywords: Sense and perception 2.Visual sense 3.Auditory sense 4.Somatosensory sense 5.Gustation and olfactory sense
educationalGoal: When we sense and recognize our environment or target objects, our brain processes a huge amount of information from the sensory system. Students will learn basic functions of various human sensory systems.
advice: We will cover the following topics: 1. Basic characteristics and psychophysical measurement of the sensory system 2. Structure and function of the visual information processing system in the periphery and central nervous system 3. Structure and function of the auditory information processing system in the periphery and central nervous system 4. Overview of the somatosensory and tactile information systems 5. Overview of the gustation and olfactory information systems 6. Higher brain functions such as perceptual information processing, memory and learning
requiredKnowledge: No prior knowledge is required, but it is recommended that students complete the “Basic Biology”, “Structure and Function in Physiology” and “Neuroscience” courses.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the basic concepts of psychophysical measurement.
Ability to explain the basic structure of the visual system and its functions.
Ability to explain the basics of the auditory system and sound perception.
Ability to explain the basics of the somatosensory system and its functional localization of the brain.
Ability to explain the basics of gustation and olfactory sense.
